description: pkix-revocation/tests/ocsp_checker_tests.rs line 181: doc comment says 'hashes differ → OcspStatusUnknown' but after the OcspCertIdMismatch fix the actual error is OcspSignatureInvalid (sig fires first) or OcspCertIdMismatch (if sig passed). title: Stale test comment: cross-CA OCSP test doc says OcspStatusUnknown, now OcspCertIdMismatch
